items.title: ExxonMobil Holdings (XOM) Awards Rovuma LNG Contracts, Does It Look Fully Valued?
items.summary: ExxonMobil Holdings (XOM) moved higher after its Mozambique unit and Area 4 partners awarded about US$1.1b in pre investment contracts for the Rovuma LNG Phase 1 project, advancing early development work.
